title: ALX Content Envelope
description: Machine-readable structure for typed content stored inside Block.content. Using this envelope is optional — opaque content remains valid without it.
$comment: This schema defines optional content semantics only. It does not change core Block validity, Block identity, or hash derivation.

definitionLevel.description: Content definition tier — determines which additional fields are required in this envelope.

contentType.description: Application-defined content type for this artifact. Required when definitionLevel is typed or higher.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the content schema governing the data field. Required when definitionLevel is schema-bound or conformance-bound.

schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema governing the data field. Required when definitionLevel is schema-bound or conformance-bound.

conformanceProfile.description: Named conformance profile the content claims to satisfy. Required when definitionLevel is conformance-bound.

index.description: Machine-readable index fields for search and retrieval. Required when definitionLevel is indexed or higher.

data.description: The artifact payload. Interpreted according to contentType and schema when definitionLevel is typed or higher; opaque otherwise.
